name: AppsPlus Software Scan Redirect Manager
author: dimasappsplus

sections.description:
AppsPlus Software Scan Redirect Manager lets site administrators create and manage dynamic redirect QR codes using their own WordPress domain.

The WordPress.org plugin is free and fully functional. It does not require an account, license key, payment, subscription, or external service.

Features included in this plugin:

  • Create and manage multiple dynamic redirect QR codes.
  • Change a QR code’s destination without replacing the printed QR code.
  • Enable or disable individual QR codes.
  • Download standard black-and-white QR codes as PNG files.
  • Track total scans for each QR code.
  • Keep redirect and scan data in your WordPress database.

A separately distributed commercial add-on is available from Apps Plus Software for organizations that want additional design, export, reporting, and commercial support capabilities. The add-on and its functionality are not included in this WordPress.org plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate AppsPlus Software Scan Redirect Manager.
  3. Open Scan Redirect in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create a QR code and enter its destination URL.
  5. Download the PNG and use it where needed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an account or license key?

No. The WordPress.org plugin works without an account or license key.

How many QR codes can I create?

The WordPress.org plugin does not impose a QR-code quota.

Can I change a destination after printing a QR code?

Yes. The QR points to a redirect URL on your WordPress site, so you can change the destination later without changing the printed QR code.

Does the plugin use an external QR or redirect service?

No. Redirects, QR generation, and scan totals are handled by the plugin on your WordPress site.

Is there a commercial add-on?

Yes. Apps Plus Software distributes a separate commercial add-on for additional capabilities. Its code is not included in this WordPress.org package.
